Name: Admin confirmed user compromised
Description: An admin marked the user as compromised.

Name: Anomalous token
Description: Abnormal token characteristics, e.g. unusual lifetime or replay from an unfamiliar location (possible token replay).

Name: Anomalous user activity
Description: Anomalous administrative behaviour, e.g. suspicious changes to the directory.

Name: Anonymous IP address
Description: Sign-in from an anonymous IP address, e.g. Tor browser or anonymous VPN.

Name: Attacker in the Middle
Description: Authentication session linked to a malicious reverse proxy (AiTM).

Name: Possible attempt to access Primary Refresh Token (PRT)
Description: Possible attempt to access the Primary Refresh Token, reported by Defender for Endpoint.

Name: Suspicious MFA authentication approval
Description: Unfamiliar properties during an Authenticator MFA approval indicate possible social engineering or phishing.

Name: Additional risk detected
Description: A premium detection was triggered. Details require Microsoft Entra ID P2.

Name: Microsoft Entra threat intelligence
Description: Activity unusual for the user or consistent with known attack patterns (Microsoft threat intelligence).

Name: Microsoft Entra threat intelligence (sign-in linked)
Description: Legacy value, not documented on the current Microsoft page.

Name: Leaked credentials
Description: The user's valid credentials appeared in a known credential breach (always high risk).

Name: Malicious IP address
Description: Sign-in from an IP address with a high failure rate or bad reputation.

Name: Malicious IP address (valid credentials, blocked IP)
Description: Legacy value, not documented on the current Microsoft page.

Name: Malware linked IP address
Description: Sign-in from an IP address infected with malware. Deprecated.

Name: Mass access to sensitive files
Description: Unusually many potentially sensitive SharePoint or OneDrive files accessed (Defender for Cloud Apps).

Name: Impossible travel
Description: Activity from distant locations in less time than travel would take (Defender for Cloud Apps).

Name: Suspicious inbox manipulation rules
Description: Suspicious inbox rules that delete or move messages or folders (Defender for Cloud Apps).

Name: Verified threat actor IP
Description: Sign-in from an IP address associated with nation-state actors or cybercrime groups (MSTIC).

Name: New country
Description: Activity from a new or infrequent country (Defender for Cloud Apps).

Name: Password spray
Description: Password spray attack in which the attacker successfully validated the user's password.

Name: Activity from anonymous IP address
Description: Activity from an anonymous proxy IP address (Defender for Cloud Apps).

Name: Suspicious API traffic
Description: Abnormal Graph API traffic or directory enumeration (possible reconnaissance).

Name: Suspicious browser
Description: Suspicious sign-in activity across multiple tenants from different countries in the same browser.

Name: Suspicious inbox forwarding
Description: Suspicious email forwarding rules, e.g. to an external address (Defender for Cloud Apps).

Name: Suspicious IP address
Description: Sign-in from an IP address known to be malicious at the time of sign-in. Legacy value.

Name: Suspicious sending patterns
Description: Suspicious email sending behaviour (Defender for Office 365).

Name: Token issuer anomaly
Description: The SAML token issuer is potentially compromised; token claims are unusual or match attacker patterns.

Name: Unfamiliar sign-in properties
Description: Sign-in with properties (IP, ASN, location, device, browser) unfamiliar to the user.

Name: Atypical travel
Description: Two sign-ins from distant locations, at least one atypical for the user.

Name: User reported suspicious activity
Description: The user denied an MFA prompt and reported it as suspicious.
